feeds.title: Myeloma UK News
feeds.description: Myeloma UK is a source of information on myeloma diagnosis, symptoms, causes, and treatments. Myeloma UK is the only organization in the UK dealing exclusively with the blood cancer myeloma.

feeds.title: ScienceDaily News » Multiple Myeloma
feeds.description: ScienceDaily is your source for the latest research news. Read the latest news and information about multiple myeloma and related conditions, including potential symptoms, causes, and treatments of the disease.

feeds.title: Debs' Journey with Myeloma
feeds.description: Deb Gascoyne is a wife & mom who has been living with Myeloma. She has used her diagnosis of myeloma to allow focusing on what she can achieve. This blog is a way to share her thoughts going through this diagnosis.

feeds.title: Tahoe Girl Blog
feeds.description: This is a blog about my multiple myeloma journey and everyday life. Never miss a post by subscribing.

feeds.title: Ian's Myeloma Blog, and more...
feeds.description: A source where Ian Crisp writes about a daily record of his time with Multiple Myeloma and diagnosis.

feeds.title: Notes from the Far Beyond Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about my experiences as a cancer patient and the thoughts that come up, fermented, and distilled in the course of my life down here in Cornwall. Observations on life, on West Penwith where I live, on the state of the world, history, soul matters, geopolitics, prehistory, the future, astrology, aid, and development, or the owls down in the woods below the farm.

feeds.title: Riding The Wave
feeds.description: A Caregiver's Inspirational Journey Through Cancer. You'll find the latest articles on Chrono Journey, Life & Kids, Caregiver Thoughts & Tips, and Myeloma Health Updates.

feeds.title: Dial M for Myeloma
feeds.description: Alex Bicknell started this blog to keep his friends and family up to date with the treatment progress. Articles cover living with myeloma, remission, relapse, Velcade, bortezomib, stem cell transplant, SCT, and much more.

feeds.title: Greg's bout with Multiple Myeloma
feeds.description: This is a blog by Greg Jones sharing his journey living with multiple myeloma. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: My Smoldering Life
feeds.description: In September of 2016, I was diagnosed with Smoldering Multiple Myeloma. I plan on using this blog to share my story so others that find themselves in the same situation can understand that this diagnosis doesn't have to be a death sentence but instead a chance to step back from the hustle and bustle of life and slow things down and enjoy what you can control.

feeds.title: Couldausedanotherday
feeds.description: A blog all about living and dying with Multiple Myeloma (and other cancers). Authored by Scott.

feeds.title: Lens on Myeloma
feeds.description: Multiple Myeloma from a patient's perspective. I am Mark Pouley, a multiple myeloma patient. I started writing about my experience with multiple myeloma about a year after I was diagnosed and well into my treatment. Through this blog, I share my stories & answer questions others have about being a myeloma patient.

feeds.title: Myeloma Research News
feeds.description: Myeloma Research News is a digital news publication dedicated to offering comprehensive daily news coverage of myeloma.
